for  R-2 along with R-2 in perso  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NAVIN CHAWLA  ORDER % 10.04.2024 1.
On mentioning of the matter by the learned counsels for the parties, the petition is taken up for hearing.

2. As the FIR, that is, FIR No.861/2020 registered at Police Station: Sagarpur, New Delhi, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and all other proceedings arising therefrom have been quashed by this Court on the basis of settlement arrived at between the petitioners and the respondent no.2 in CRL.M.C. 2882/2024, the present petition is rendered infructuous and the learned counsel for the petitioners prays for leave to withdraw the same.
3.
The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.
The pending application also stands disposed of as being rendered This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/04/2024 at 23:17:20 infructuous.
4. The next date of hearing, that is, 10.07.2024 shall stand cancelled.
